content:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Orchid Labs QBR next Wed. Need a short pre-read (~5 slides) covering onboarding health, commit/credits runway, and cost controls. They had a 3x token spike after embedding rollout last Thurs. Can @aj_finops and @lucas_se run a quick forecast and flag risks?

aj_finops: On it. I'll pull last 30 days and run a 90-day runway under current usage + modeled embed growth. Quick ask: do we want to recommend soft throttles or quota alerts?

lucas_se: Recommend soft throttles + adaptive batching first. We can set short-term prefix caching for their most common flows. Needs a config change on their Dedicated pool if they want lower tail latency.

maria_cs: Good. Also capture enablement asks — they asked for a short checklist for best-practices to avoid repeat spikes.

jess_prod: I can draft a one-page playbook: alerts, quota tiers, suggested batching/quantization, and an onboarding checklist for client eng. Will include exact API knobs.

sam_eng: For forecasting, here's the quick query I use to get rolling burn by feature:
```sql
SELECT feature, SUM(tokens) as tokens_30d
FROM usage
WHERE account='orchid-labs' AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY 1;
```
I'll share results in a sec.

aj_finops: Raw numbers: past 30d tokens=22.4M, embeddings=9.8M tokens. If embed adoption +20%/mo, 90-day median burn ~85M tokens. With current credits they hit warning at ~60 days. Two options: 1) propose a short-term commit to extend runway 60->180 days, or 2) implement quota + adaptive batching to flatten peaks.

maria_cs: We should push both: commit option for execs + enablement checklist for devs. Jess — can you include the commit ask language? Also we need a slide with 'action items' and owners.

jess_prod: Yep. Draft will include language: "Recommended 3-month flexible commit: $X/month leads to Y% discount and 90d runway cushion." Will add action owners and a rollback/fallback plan.

deploy-bot: Deployment: feature/soft-throttle-config pushed to staging at 11:12am — smoke tests passed. :white_check_mark:

lucas_se: I'll coordinate a quick test with Orchid staging tomorrow to validate latency under batching.

maria_cs: Awesome. Can everyone add any blockers by EOD Friday? I'll assemble the pre-read Monday morning. :sparkles:

aj_finops: Adding a note — set budget alert at 60% so we have time to trigger throttles and customer outreach.

maria_cs: Great. Thanks team. I'll ping execs once we have numbers and the slide draft.
